title: T226 PNC - The Wicked Sing Melodies of Sadness — Their Soul Is from the Mixed Multitude
hebrewTitle: הרשעים שרים ניגוני בכי — נשמתם מן הערב רב
author: Petten Nanach

beginner.en: The wicked tend to sing melodies of wailing, sadness, and grief — not melodies of joy. This is because their souls are rooted in the "mixed multitude" (erev rav) who left Egypt together with Israel, bringing a subtle spiritual corruption. The mother of the erev rav is Lilith, the force of bitter sadness and spiritual darkness. Those whose souls draw from this source are naturally pulled toward music that expresses longing and loss rather than joy and light. The quality of someone's inner music reveals the quality of their soul's root.

intermediate.en: T226: The wicked prefer melodies of wailing and sadness (neginot yilelah v'atzvut) because their neshama is rooted in the erev rav (mixed multitude), whose spiritual mother is Lilith — the force of bitter sadness. Soul-root determines musical inclination. LM 226.
intermediate.he: הרשעים שרים ניגוני יללה ועצבות — כי נשמתם מן הערב רב, ואם הערב רב היא לילית, כוח העצבות המרה.

scholarly.he: LM א׳ רכו׳ — "הרשעים בעיקר שרים ניגוני יללה ועצבות... כי הם בחינת נשמת ערב רב ואמם לילית".
